deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's flow
Independent third-party security audit with remediation report
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator under the TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The withdrawal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursements.

The proposed Phase 2 deliverables include a secondary marketplace, smart-contract royalty splits, anti-scalping rules, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The proposal projects 12-month outcomes of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6M+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
Sellout is described as having 200,000+ registered users, 250,000+ tickets issued to date, and 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move $6M+ through Cardano in Year 1.
The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with independent oversight and public dashboard tracking.
Anvil claims a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through Anvil infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada to fund an 8-month Phase 2 build for a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect administration, claimed Sellout adoption base, projected on-chain usage, and a contractual revenue-share repayment structure.
